title: Composite air filtering and vacuum/pressure release device

features.item: Main body with suction surface on one side
features.quote: The second end of the cylinder is provided with a base assembly (3) for securing the composite device to a vessel.
features.note: The base assembly (3) acts as a main body for securing the device to a vessel, implying a surface for contact.
features.refuted: The quote describes a base assembly for securing to a vessel, but does not teach that the main body has a suction surface on one side.
